snippet.title: Fishing Update Launch Trailer - Alchemica - Crafting RPG
snippet.description:
A new mini-game is now available in Alchemica: Fishing! 
- Play the mini-game and catch various kinds of fish!
- Compete against other players! 
- Obtain cool items that will help Charlotte in her journey, including a brand new Arkana doll!

Alchemica - Crafting RPG is a free game on Android where you gather, craft, and sell items in your very own shop. 

Journey as Charlotte, a young girl returning to her hometown as an alchemist, pursuing her dream to become a successful merchant. Little does she know of her role in determining the fate of her world...

Play Store link: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gdi.crunchybit.alchemica
